On this trip, Guy Fieri's got Asian flavors, an American classic and some mashups in between. In Anchorage, there's a Korean-Mexican joint rollin' out kimchi burritos and wild wings. In Aspen, it's a smokehouse run by a former dentist puttin' his own twist on ribs, and in Old Town Albuquerque, a funky fusion food truck-turned-brick-n-mortar spot heads off the charts with a flavorful veggie specialty and the bomb pork belly.

videos.title: Meaty, Cheesy and Sweet
videos.overview:
Highlands Alehouse (Aspen, Colo.) • Waffles and Whatnot (Anchorage, Alaska) • Guava Tree Café (Albuquerque, N.M.)

On this trip, Guy Fieri's finding things meaty, cheesy and a little sweet. In Aspen Highlands, a ski hot spot elevatin' their slopeside menu with loaded carnitas nachos and sizzlin' steak tacos. In Anchorage, there's a wild waffle house pilin' up both sweet and savory masterpieces. Plus, in Albuquerque, a lights-out Latin joint goin' big with their amazing arepas and prime-time pork paninis.

videos.title: From Appetizers to Dessert
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's digging into appetizers, dessert and everything in-between. In Laramie, Wyo., an old-school cafe is loadin' up the bomb green-chili burritos and serving stellar scratch-made pie. In Albuquerque, N.M., a vegetarian joint is packin' flavor into their no-meat loaf and cauliflower "wings." And, in Anchorage, Alaska, a funky spot is going next level with their blackened chicken gnocchi and a sweet-and-savory focaccia starter.

videos.title: Gettin' Funky in Flavortown
videos.overview: On this trip, Guy Fieri's grabbing all kinds of funky flavor. In Laramie, Wyo., a righteous restaurant-bar is pilin' up their nachos and putting a special pop in their burgers. Plus, a longtime spot is cookin' up a vegetarian spin on both meatloaf and a banh mi sandwich. Then, in Anchorage, Alaska, a Mexican joint is serving dynamite duck tacos and off-the-chain chorizo.

videos.title: From Italian to Asian
videos.overview:
Originale Caffè & Deli (Anchorage, Alaska) • Coda Bakery Vietnamese Deli & Tofu House (Albuquerque, N.M.) • The Crowbar & Grill (Laramie, Wyo.)

Guy Fieri's diving into global flavors, starting at a real-deal Italian deli in Anchorage servin' up magical and devilish sandwiches. Then on to an Albuquerque spot rockin' an out-of-bounds Duc Biet banh mi. Plus, the Triple-D-inspired Wyoming joint meldin' cultures with Bulgogi fries and their Billhook lamb-feta-tzatziki pizza.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Poultry, Lamb and Jam
videos.overview: Guy Fieri's got breakfast, lunch, dinner and drinks, starting in Columbus, Ohio, where he loads up on a meatball sub; Guy turns his attention to creative cocktails and a jammin' turkey burger in Edison, N.J., and shawarma in Lansing, Mich.

videos.title: Pickin' Up and Chowin' Down
videos.overview:
Rowley Inn (Cleveland, Ohio) • Alibi Wood Fire Pizzaria and Bakery (Laramie, Wyo.) • Ray's Place (Anchorage, Alaska)

This trip, Guy's rollin' out to places perfect for pickin' up and chowin' down. In Cleveland, a funky bar across the street from a Christmas classic makin' monster tots and a Hawaiian-Polish mashup. In Wyoming, a powerhouse pizza-bakery firin' up barbecue pie and standout sandwiches.  And in Anchorage, a Vietnamese spot cookin' up amazing crepes and flavor-bomb chicken.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Out of Bounds Burgers
videos.overview: Guy Fieri's got a mouth full of the best burgers, starting with a Cali-inspired chorizo burger in Blue Ash, OH. There's a strawberry jam-packed double patty in Nashville, and a burger joint in Ann Arbor, MI, is making 'em a million different ways.

videos.title: Food Network Super Chefs
videos.overview:
Mabel's BBQ (Cleveland, Ohio) • Chaatable (Nashville, Tenn.)

Guy Fieri's hitting up joints owned by Food Network super chefs. Like Michael Symon's barbeque spot in Cleveland, where he's firin' up pork belly and brisket. Then on to Nashville, where Maneet Chauhan is servin' up her creative spin on Indian recipes.

videos.title: Plating Up Puerto Rico
videos.overview: Guy Fieri's travelling with Antonia Lofaso on a culinary journey through Puerto Rico. In Old San Juan, they're diggin' into a chicken-trifongo combo; a spot in Juncos is servin' up plantain-picadillo lasagna and a stew made with pig's feet.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Old Friends, New Flavors
videos.overview:
Kesté Pizza & Vino (Manhattan, N.Y.) • Joe's Gizzard City Café (Potterville, Mich.) • Taste of Belgium (Cincinnati, Ohio)

On this trip, old friends are whippin' up new flavors.  In Manhattan's Financial District, Guy follows a Triple D alum to his new place to check out old-school pizza and a new level of lasagna. Then, it's back to the south-central Michigan place known for its gizzards - where they're frying everything from burgers to breakfast sandwiches. Plus the Belgian bistro in Cincinnati still servin' waffles every which way.

videos.title: Chicken, Steak and Cake
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's doubling up with sweet and savory, both hot and cold. In San Juan, Puerto Rico, a Venezuelan food stand is serving up amazing arepas with off-the-chain chicken and stellar steak. In Laramie, Wyo., a funky food truck is scoring with winning wings, including a star NFL quarterback's favorite. And in Cleveland, a two-for-one spot is making an outrageous ice cream-cake combo alongside a raclette-ramen mashup.

videos.title: Flavor Expedition
videos.overview:
Salao Tapas & Bar (Caguas, P.R.) - Fat Cats (Cleveland, Ohio) - Haldi Chowk 35 Indian Bistro (Middletown, N.J.)

This trip, Guy's embarking on a worldwide journey of flavor: In Caguas, Puerto Rico, a tapas-and-more joint puttin' out international bites like churrasco steak and ropa vieja dumplings. In Cleveland, a funky bar servin' next-level dishes with Filipino flair. And in suburban Jersey, an Indian spot cookin' up real deal recipes like tandoori chicken and over-the-top samosas.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Covered and Smothered
videos.overview: Guy Fieri pops into a Jewish deli in Palm Springs, CA, to reminisce about pastrami and brisket. Then, it's double trouble with Kid Rock in Clarkston, MI, and a look back at not one but two of Kid's favorite hometown restaurants.

videos.title: Surf and Savory
videos.overview: Guy Fieri's grabbing a little surf, turf and flavors from the earth. In Puerto Rico, a local gem is serving off-the-hook pork trifongo and shrimp empanadas. Plus, Guy finds a mushroom po' boy in Somerville, NJ, and outrageous octopus in Cleveland.

videos.title: From Chicken to Chiles
videos.overview:
Chúla (La Quinta, Calif.) • Good Company (Cleveland, Ohio) • The Chubby Pickle (Highlands, N.J.)

This trip, Guy's findin' all kinds of unexpected flavor. In the Cali desert, a creative chef puttin' a new spin on familiar recipes, like her Mom's chilaquiles and a crazy Monte Cristo. In Cleveland, an Iron Chef tags along to a joint runnin' sandwiches off the rails, including one that's a mouthful in more ways than one! And in New Jersey, a funky sports bar with an unforgettable name ampin' up bar bites like Korean wings and pork tacos.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Classic Plates New Tastes
videos.overview: On this road trip, Guy Fieri's finding new takes on classic favs. First up in Palm Desert, Calif., Guy pops into a place servin' avocado fries and a burger with an Italian accent. Then, soul food -- like pigs' feet and St. Louis-style ribs -- gets a Jersey twist in Atlantic City, N.J. And in Lansing, Mich., a barbecue joint puts their own take on bruschetta.

videos.title: Cruisin Coast to Coast
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's digging into flavor coast to coast. In Indio, Calif., he's hittin' up a taco joint going above and beyond with their torta ahogada and a quesadilla-taco-au jus mashup. In Sea Bright, N.J., a legit Thai spot is piling up the pork and dynamite dumplings. And a funky food truck in Bridgewater Township, N.J., is loadin' up monster sandwiches.

videos.title: Stellar Sandwiches and Big-Time Burgers
videos.overview:
East Side Banh Mi (Nashville, Tenn.) • Gastro Grind Burgers (Palm Desert, Calif.) • The Real Italian Deli (Palm Desert, Calif.)

On this trip, Guy's unhingin' his jaw for off-the-hook sandwiches and out-of-bounds burgers. in Nashville, a Vietnamese spot makin' a bomb bánh mì and mind-blowin' steak and rice bowls. In the Cali desert, a husband-wife joint grindin' all their own meats for standard, deluxe, and outrageous hoity-toity fancy-pants burgers.  And stayin' in Palm Desert, a market-deli pilin' up Italian porchetta on scratch-made focaccia.

videos.title: Cheese and Meat
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's gettin' cheesy and meaty, starting in South Bound Brook, N.J., where a meat market with an unforgettable chef is stacking up their spin on the sloppy joe and baking a fully stuffed bread. In Nashville, a taco joint is pilin' up a carne asada bowl and nachos with hot local flavor. Plus, there's a down-home spot serving craft beer, a dynamite dip and the bomb barbecue pork mac.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: From Fried to Sides
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's throwin' everything in the fryer! His first stop is an O.G. Triple D in Knoxville, Tenn., where the pizza, onion rings and fried chicken come straight to your car. Then, crunchy crab cakes are gettin' all spiced up in Somers Point, N.J., and a popular pub in Blue Ash, Ohio, had to make more room for their crispy pig tails and humongous hot dogs.

videos.title: From Chicken to Cheesesteak
videos.overview: On this trip, Guy Fieri's diggin' into chicken and some crazy creations. In Palm Springs, Calif., a crepe spot is all about the savory with barbecue bird and cheesesteak fillings, while a funky joint is cookin' up real deal Mexican pollo and chicharrones. In Nashville, an Egyptian food truck is firing up hot wings and their falafel waffle specialty.

videos.title: Burger, Bird and Meaty Italian
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's diving into a meaty smorgasbord. In Nashville, a funky neighborhood joint is serving up loaded carne fries and a skyscraper burger, and in New Smyrna Beach, Fla., a rockin' chef is cooking up real deal gnocchi and Grandma's hands-on pizza recipe. Plus, a spot with an out-of-this-world atmosphere is going huge with monster pork chops and an Italian meat extravaganza.

videos.title: Stuffed, Smoked and Wrapped
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri is pickin' up what Flavortown is puttin' down. In Nashville, a funky neighborhood joint is loading up the tots and adding green chile crunch to their signature wrap. And in Daytona Beach, Fla., a local gem is servin' up off-the-hook seafood and smokin' up amazing alligator ribs. Plus, at the beach, a breezy spot is all about Venezuelan specialties, like piled-up plantain goodness and stuffed chicken arepas.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Kaleidoscope
videos.overview: Guy Fieri looks for culinary creations you can really sink your teeth into, including a New Hampshire catering truck full of beef tips, shrimp and dirty bird wings. Then, there's rockin' pierogis in Ohio and homemade gnocchi at a New Jersey eatery.

videos.title: Eastern Southern
videos.overview: Guy Fieri's heading east to get a taste of the South. A real deal smokehouse in New Hampshire is putting their own spin on meatloaf, a funky North Carolina joint is spicin' up their shrimp and a historic Florida spot is making a standout seafood stew.

videos.title: Rolled and Holed
videos.overview:
Big Dave’s Bagels & Deli (North Conway, N.H.) • Third Wave Café & Wine Bar (New Smyrna Beach, Fla.) • Floyd’s 1921 (Morehead City, N.C.)

This trip, Guy's rollin’ out for a little "holey" moley. In New Hampshire, a Jersey-style joint  puttin' out bomb bagels and unique sweets. Right on the beach in Florida, a fun chef goin' prime time with pastrami ribs and wood-fired pizza. And in North Carolina, a funky spot addin’ a Southern spin to egg rolls and elevatin’ shrimp and grits.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Soups, Stews and Seafood
videos.overview: Host Guy Fieri travels across America in search of the best diners, drive-ins and dives. He visits classic "greasy spoon" restaurants and talks to staff and customers about the food. Episodes often feature eateries linked by a common theme, such as burgers or comfort food.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: From Sausage to Sweet
videos.overview: On this trip, Guy Fieri's got sweet and savory. First up in Pembroke, N.C., he stops by a never-seen-before treat truck to try some knock-out candy apples. Then, an old school diner in Jersey City may have gotten a new name, but the pancakes are still the same. Down the road in Brigantine, N.J., a tried-and-true butcher shop is still grinding and stuffing sausage.

videos.title: Beef and Bird
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's loading up the meat with bomb beef and bird. In North Conway, N.H., a funky joint is putting Thai into their tacos and punching up their piccata. In Emerald Isle, N.C., a local gem is firing up monster barbecue. Then in Taos, a traditional spot is serving up real deal New Mexican specialties.

videos.title: Not-Your-Everyday, All Day
videos.overview: Guy Fieri's diggin' into not-your-everyday dishes, all day long. In Taos, N.M., there's a sweet, stacked-up breakfast and a unique pot pie twist, plus cheffed-up Mexican recipes you won't find on a typical menu. Then, skate legend Tony Hawk is along for the ride in San Diego, grabbin' crazy creative vegan cooking.

videos.title: Culinary Adventure
videos.overview:
Tuétana Taquería / Mar Rustico (San Diego, Calif.) • Shawarma Guys (San Diego, Calif.) • Donabe Asian Kitchen (Taos, N.M.)

This trip, Guy's jumpin' into a full culinary adventure. In Old Town San Diego, with a two-for-one spot servin' Baja-style seafood and rich bone marrow tacos.  Stayin' in San Diego, a funky Middle Eastern food truck puttin' out next-level shawarma rated best in the U.S.A. And in New Mexico, a pan-Asian joint pullin' out the all stops with curry noodles and a bison Reuben bánh mì.

videos.title: Revved Up
videos.overview: If there’s one thing that’s synonymous with DDD, it's Guy Fieri's Rojo Red '68 Camaro. This car has been on his road trip around the country for years, and she is tired. Guy and his buddies at VP Speed Shop are retooling another '68 Camaro to be an identical twin sister that even Guy won't be able to tell apart. When he stops in for check-ins, he'll bring some of his favorite dishes from local places around the area. Plus, we'll look back on how the Camaro became Guy's sidekick as we revisit some of its best gags, celebrity encounters and food-centric shenanigans.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Burgers, Bowls and Bangers
videos.overview: In a bowl or on a bun, this trip's got it all! First up, Guy pops into a poke truck he found at the Ferndale County Fair for some island-inspired flavors. Then in Hackensack, N.J., a diner is still serving sliders and steak sandwiches you can eat by the truckload. Plus, a popular Palm Desert, Calif., spot has savory and sweet breakfast options to satisfy any palate, including frosted pastries and a banger benny.

videos.title: Thai, Pie and Fries
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's diving into Thai food, pie and some hearty fries. In San Diego, an amazing Asian spot is servin' phenomenal fried fish and righteous ribs. Plus, in Arroyo Seco, N.M., a New Zealand food truck is making mouthwatering meat pies and a modern comfort joint is cooking up a mushroom masterpiece and loaded bison chili fries.

videos.title: West Coast Wonders
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's cruisin' California for some West Coast wonders. In Healdsburg, a rooftop oasis is firing up pork belly pizza and creating a charcuterie cornucopia. In San Diego, a funky joint is dishing out a real deal taste of New Orleans, and a scratch breakfast/lunch spot is going over-the-top with sweet and savory.

videos.title: Smoker, Stove & Stewer
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's checkin' out all kinds of culinary. In Las Vegas, a BBQ food truck is smokin' up monster sandwiches, and in Santa Barbara, Calif., a comfort spot is putting out primo pot pie and shrimp curry. Plus, a Mediterranean joint is knockin' it out of the park with beef skewers and tandoori chicken.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Chick'in Out
videos.overview: From chicken to chickpeas, this road trip's got it all! First up in Santa Fe, N.M., Guy Fieri checks in on an African joint to taste their extra special oxtail and a downhome stew that'll warm you right up. Then, a café in New Jersey is still pressing paninis and stuffing sandwiches in two locations and growing. Finally, a Brooklyn spot is servin' traditional Southern sides in Super Bowl portions with enough mac and cheese, fried pickles and collards to feed the whole team.

videos.title: Interesting Italian
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's diggin' into all kinds of Italian. In Santa Barbara, Calif., Dennis Miller is riding shotgun for a taste of prime-time pizza and amazing arancini. In Las Vegas, a vegan joint is puttin' their spin on an Italian "meat" sandwich, plus a funky pizzeria is stuffing chicken parm into a spectacular stromboli.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: From Crab Cakes to Curry
videos.overview: On this trip, Guy Fieri's crossing the country for off-the-hook culinary creations! In Santa Fe, N.M., Guy goes bananas for a banana curry. Then in Las Vegas, a trio representing both coasts has tripled their real estate all thanks to pineapple on their pizza. Plus, they've got a new kind of pie getting rave reviews. Finally, clams and crab cakes in Leeds Point, N.J., are creating all kinds of buzz.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Mac Daddy Meat
videos.overview: It's a full-blown meat-fest on this road trip! First up, Guy Fieri stops to check out a BBQ joint in Las Vegas that's doin' burnt ends and meatloaf in a totally different way. Then in Belmar, New Jersey, a Mexi-Cali must-stop is stuffin' street tacos like you’d find South of the Border. Just across the state in Rocky Hill is burgers and fries you can't find anywhere else!

videos.title: All-Over Flavor
videos.overview: On this trip, Guy Fieri's bathing in flavorful finds. In Santa Barbara, Calif., he takes Marc Summers to check out fried rice served in a bowl and in a burrito. Then, he's off to Las Vegas with Hunter for real deal Jamaican. We're talkin' island-inspired festival, jerk chicken and escovitch fish. Plus in Florida, the most un-Boca Boca restaurant is dishing out lobster meatballs and pork cheek empanadas.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: All Wrapped Up
videos.overview: From coast to coast, Guy Fieri's wrapping up all kinds of grub. First up in Vegas, a crepe shop is folding up everything from pork to peaches. Then in Santa Barbara, California, there's killer carnitas and green chile verde that hasn't changed, while in Robbinsville, New Jersey, real deal Italian dishes like prosciutto bread and chicken parm are served straight out of the deli case.

videos.title: Chicken and Ribs
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's flyin' with chicken and so much more. In Santa Barbara, California, a butcher-restaurant combo is saucing up their chicken tacos and going fried on a stellar sandwich. In Delray Beach, Florida, an homage to mom includes a mouthwatering meaty pasta and off-the-hook seafood stew. Then in Las Vegas, a wild chef is going over the top with his gorgeous Thai creations.

videos.title: Meat and Sweet
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's pilin' up the meat along with a little sweet. In Santa Barbara, California, a hidden gem is puttin' out funky fusion like fried chicken bao buns and Korean paella. In Boynton Beach, Florida, a bomb butcher is creating elevated porchetta and scratch-made hot dogs. In Boca Raton, Florida, a food truck is stacking up a carnivore's dream and cooking brownie cheesecake right into a jar.

videos.title: Mexican, Mediterranean and Mofongo
videos.overview:
Hellenic Republic (Coral Springs, Fla.) • Letty’s de Letecia’s Cocina (Las Vegas, Nev.) • La Cosinita Latina (West Palm Beach, Fla.)

This trip, Guy's grabbin’ an international assortment of flavor. First up, a funky Florida spot puttin’ their Mediterranean spin on lamb burgers and fried shrimp. In Las Vegas, an O.G. Mexican joint servin’ up the-bomb birria tacos, magnificent mole and a wild take on margaritas. And in West Palm Beach, a familiar face at a local gem dishin’ out primo Puerto Rican specialties like a lobster mofongo.

videos.title: A World of Meat
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's digging into meaty mashups from all over the world. In Boise, Idaho, a Russian joint is servin' up lights-out lamb and out-of-this-world dumplings. Plus, a Pakistani spot is cooking authentic dishes like flavorful goat and righteous rice. In Ocala, Fla., a barbecue pro is puttin' his delicious spin on smoky ribs, brisket mac and cheese-stuffed sausage.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: All Sorts of Sandwiches
videos.overview: On this trip down memory lane, Guy Fieri's eating all sorts of sandwiches, from fried to "pied." First up, in Boise, Idaho, an old school drive-in is deep-dunking their Monte Cristos. In Atlantic City, pork rolls and patties are all wrapped up in pizza dough. Finally, a pizza joint in Las Vegas is stuffin', seedin' and saucin' East Coast-inspired eats.

videos.title: Pick-Me-Ups
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's picking up handfuls of flavor. In Boise, Idaho, a real deal empanada emporium and a stick-to-your-ribs spot are both servin' up off-the-hook burgers and sandwiches. Then, a funky joint in Savannah is puttin' out wood-fired pizza and bagels that are all over the map.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: From Biscuits to Briskets
videos.overview: On this trip, Guy Fieri's tasting food from coast to coast and across the pond. First up, Guy's eating Irish-inspired egg rolls in Atlantic Beach, Florida. Then, there's bacon jam and mile-high meatloaf from the 18th hole in Vincentown, N.J., and an all-American breakfast with an English twist in Ventura, California.

videos.title: Seafood, Spice & Soul
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's grabbing seaside snacks, global spice and Southern soul. On Tybee Island, Ga., a beachy joint is going gourmet with their hot dogs and fresh seafood, while in Savannah, a real deal soul food spot is rolling out an oxtail twist and down-home peach cobbler. Then in Boise, Idaho, a café run by sisters is serving up a taste of Afghanistan with a heartwarming mission.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Dishes Done Right
videos.overview: Guy Fieri's hittin' all the flavours, from barbecue to banh mi. He enjoys rib tips under the Hollywood stars in Los Angeles, gets an Italian element on his jerk chicken in Ohio and checks out a business-busting Vietnamese-BBQ mashup in Michigan.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Pastrami, Patties and Parm
videos.overview: Guy Fieri's going across the country to sample all sorts of savory eats. He catches up on all things BBQ on St. Simons Island, GA, before heading to Los Angeles for chicken parm at an Italian deli and supersized subs loaded with plenty of fried food.

videos.title: Down South & South of the Border
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's grabbing Southern flavor and south-of-the-border style with a spin. In Tybee Island, Georgia, an old ice cream shop turned restaurant is serving standout seafood and gourmet grilled cheese, while in Savannah, there's culinary comfort cooked up in an old garage. Then in Boise, Idaho, a taco spot gone wild is blowing up the beef and getting creative with carnitas.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Island-Inspired Eats
videos.overview: On this trip, Guy Fieri's gearing up for vacation mode with Italian and island-inspired eats. First up in Manhattan Beach, Calif., there's both carbonara and Kalua pig comin' out of the same spot. Then just up the 405, Guy's sampling Lao Lao in Los Angeles. Plus, a Jamaican joint in Cincinnati's servin' a brown stew chicken wrap to-go.

videos.title: Sloppy, Saucy and Stuffed
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's diggin' into hearty helpings -- both saucy and stuffed. In Los Angeles, there's El Salvadorian with a twist, like prime-time pupusas and an extra-meaty burger. In Oregon, a food cart in a motel parking lot is serving up authentic Indian. Plus in Pooler, Ga., a Puerto Rican joint is going crazy with a mofongo mashup and their take on a sloppy joe.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Mexi-Cali Meals
videos.overview: For this trip, Guy Fieri's chowing down on South-of-the-Border bites throughout California. First up, Guy's swinging through Victorville to check in on an O.G. DDD truck stop servin' monster-sized sandwiches and scratch-made salsa. Then in Garden Grove, a generational joint is dishin' out chile verde by the vat, and a Salvadorian spot in Los Angeles may have changed hands, but the top-notch tampiquenas are still the same.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Wrapped, Stacked and Sliced
videos.overview: On this trip down memory lane, Guy Fieri's wrapping 'em up and stacking 'em high. First up, a Filipino-fusion joint relocated to California's Inland Empire, but their lumpia and spicy pork fries are worth the commute. Then in Santa Monica, an oldie but goodie is still making out-of-bounds burgers, while a staple in Boulder, Colo., is celebrating a century with their college-town classics.

videos.title: Top-Notch Toppings
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's diving into dishes with over-the-top toppings. In Cincinnati, a smokin' spot is piling up a mega pork sandwich and the city's signature chili-pasta mashup. In Bend, Ore., a vegan food trailer is getting creative with righteous rice, veggies and tostadas. Then in Venice, Calif., a real deal pizza stop is puttin' out flavorful flatbread and frying up the pie.

videos.title: Stuffed, Sandwiched and Souped
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's getting stuffed and sandwiched. In Los Angeles, a taco truck is going big with the birria and putting out tasty tostadas. In Bend, Ore., it's Polish-palooza with lights-out pierogis and a cabbage specialty. Then in Milford, Ohio, an elevated diner is spicing up their chicken sandwich and pairing short rib grilled cheese with kimchi tomato soup.

videos.title: Triple D Nation: Ocean Eats and a Chicken Feast
videos.overview: On this trip, Guy Fieri's checking out seafood sensations and fryin' up a lot of fowl. First up in Los Angeles, he's tasting a spicy Thai soup and garlic prawns from a GGG alum. Then, Guy's off to Colorado for Italian-inspired crispy cutlets in Colorado Springs and a tower of fried chicken meant for the Mile-High City.

videos.title: Dumpling-icious
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's diving into dumplings and other righteous recipes from around the world. In Cincinnati, a not-your-everyday Japanese joint is firing up meaty gyozas and a surprising Asian-pasta blend. In Sisters, Ore., a Nepalese spot is showcasing their traditional dumplings alongside a pork belly bao. Then in Los Angeles, a Lebanese-Armenian oasis is putting out stellar shawarma and a righteous regional dumpling dish.

videos.title: Tasty Time Travel
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's headed on some tasty trips back in time. There's an old schoolhouse in Camp Dennison, Ohio, with a comfort food curriculum like fried chicken and peanut butter pie. Then in Redmond, Ore., a church-turned-restaurant is putting out heavenly pizza and angelic wings, and in Stamford, Conn., a retro joint is dishing out diner classics like matzo ball soup and a taste of Thanksgiving.

videos.title: Variety of Flavor
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's hittin' up joints crushin' all kinds of flavor. There's a Malaysian oasis in Cincinnati and a Salvadorian spot in Port Chester, New York, each serving their real deal cultural specialties. Plus, an Omaha family is going Detroit-style with their pizza served straight out of a bus.

videos.title: Champion Chefs
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's visiting restaurants owned by rockstar chefs who are familiar Food Network faces. In Studio City, Calif., Chef Antonia Lofaso is cooking up out-of-this-world global flavors, from Japanese to Italian. Then in Rapid City, S.D., Chef Justin Warner is serving up righteous ramen and dynamite dumplings.

videos.title: From Chicken to Caribbean
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's flyin' from the-bomb bird to island inspiration. In Omaha, a chicken-centric spot is servin' it up fried, spiced and paired with pancakes. In Cincinnati, a hidden gem is firing up real deal Caribbean favorites. videos.title: Triple D Nation: Seafood, Schnitzel and Spam
videos.overview: This trip, Guy Fieri's headed back to top spots servin' up some fresh takes! Just outside New Orleans, a sizzlin' seafood joint has expanded, still going boat-to-table with dynamite Delacroix drum nachos and the-bomb backyard boiled crawfish. An old-school diner with a tribute to the troops in Fountain Valley, Calif., is busier than ever, dishing out smoked spam loco moco and puttin' their stamp on pot roast. Then, in Chicago, a big-time beer bar is even more of a foodie destination, plating a prime-time pork schnitzel sandwich, plus poutine with beer cheese and bacon gravy.
